run.Original_Project_description: Ankylosing spondylitis is a disease that is still hard to cure. It is often found in teenagers and has a great impact on their image and life. The differences between gut microbes and healthy people in Ankylosing Spondylitis patients have been analyzed based on data and some individualized analyses.
